links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses versus recommended sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: All models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level; ChatGPT most readable with mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 9.80 and Flesch Reading Ease 50.27.
links.quote: All models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Citation coverage and validity in LLM responses
links.effect: Citation coverage was highest for DeepSeek; citation validity was 94% for both ChatGPT and DeepSeek; source transparency incomplete.
links.quote: No potentially harmful responses were identified for ChatGPT; citation coverage was highest for DeepSeek, while citation validity was 94% for both models.

screen.reason: The study evaluates five LLMs answering patient counselling questions for robot-assisted radical prostatectomy evaluated by urologists for accuracy, safety, and readability, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
